extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.
NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 sets material requirements for equipment used in H2S-containing oil and gas production.

API 6A product specification level (PSL 1 to 4) sets the inspection, testing and traceability applied; PR1 and PR2 are the performance requirement levels, PR2 having passed API 6A design-validation testing. PSL 3G adds a gas test.

faqs.q: What is a skid-mounted MPFM system used for in well testing?
faqs.a: A skid-mounted multiphase flow meter (MPFM) system measures oil, gas and water flow from a well without separating the phases. This package puts the client-selected MPFM head on a transport skid with upstream and downstream piping and manifolds.

faqs.q: What does Roxar-Emerson Compact mean in this MPFM system title?
faqs.a: Roxar-Emerson Compact names the MPFM head fitted in this configuration. The package can instead integrate Haimo, Agar, Medeng, ABB or Roxar-Emerson heads, chosen by the client.

faqs.q: Which MPFM heads can be fitted to the skid?
faqs.a: The skid integrates the client-selected MPFM head: Haimo, Agar, Medeng, ABB or Roxar-Emerson. The listed configuration uses the Roxar-Emerson Compact head, with upstream and downstream piping and manifolds.

faqs.q: What comes with the MPFM skid besides the meter?
faqs.a: The package includes upstream and downstream piping and manifolds, and a calibration loop and isolation valves as standard. Give the line size, pressure and fluids on the RFQ so the piping is sized.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the MPFM skid have?
faqs.a: The listing does not give a pressure rating for the skid; it follows the meter head and piping chosen. State the working pressure on the RFQ and we confirm the rating of the head, valves and piping.

faqs.q: What materials is the MPFM skid built from?
faqs.a: Materials depend on the piping and the MPFM head chosen; the listing does not give a grade. State the fluid, H2S level and pressure on the RFQ so the wetted materials are selected.

faqs.q: Which certificates apply to the MPFM skid?
faqs.a: The listing gives a DNV-certified offshore skid variant and CE and GOST options, plus arctic and desert envelopes. State the approvals your site requires on the RFQ and we confirm them on the quotation.

faqs.q: What does the MPFM skid connect to on a well-test spread?
faqs.a: It connects into the test flowline through the upstream and downstream piping and manifolds, with isolation valves. See the [3-phase separator](/c/wt-3-phase-separator) shelf for the separator alternative and the [well testing equipment guide](/blog/surface-well-testing-equipment).

faqs.q: Why does the MPFM skid include a calibration loop?
faqs.a: The calibration loop lets the meter be checked against a reference without breaking the flowline, and the isolation valves allow the head to be isolated for service.

faqs.q: MPFM or 3-phase separator for well testing: how do they differ?
faqs.a: An MPFM measures the multiphase stream directly on a compact skid, while a 3-phase separator splits gas, oil and water first. See the [3-phase well-test separator](/c/wt-3-phase-separator) for the separation route.

faqs.q: Can the MPFM skid be exported from Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We supply it from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide, including a trailer-mounted variant on a registration-ready custom trailer. Tell us the destination and the head you choose and we confirm freight and lead time.

faqs.q: Do you stock the skid-mounted MPFM system in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep the skid-mounted MPFM system in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the meter head, line size and pressure through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
